independent_review_notes.loader_interpretation: The driver explicitly sets each Qt child's LD_LIBRARY_PATH, QT_PLUGIN_PATH, QT_IM_MODULE=ibus and IBUS_ADDRESS_FILE to the verified private Qt6.5.3/input-method environment. Any original system_qt_loader_not_overridden field is not evidence of unmodified child loader environment or stock system Qt. No system package or global service was changed.
independent_review_notes.asset_review: 196 distinct scope/project assets, including 28 original PNGs, matched existing SHA256 and size; the reviewer did not reread 20 dependency-tree references outside that limited scope.
independent_review_notes.source_review: All 12 original source-check logs have 113 successful lines; the driver uses subprocess check=True and all four final native exits are zero. The logs do not have independent per-check exit files. A current 113-file recheck exited zero.
independent_review_notes.database_review: The root agent independently rechecked the four exact native-run database names through a read-only pg_database query after the runs; count zero, psql exit zero.
independent_review_notes.limits: Candidate proximity is not exact preedit glyph/caret pixel validation. The proof concerns two flows, four application DPRs and the recorded finite observation windows, not all IMEs, hardware/OS DPI, whole-EGC visual correctness or campaign completion.
